scope: DXF MOTIONPATH and ACDBCURVEPATH object record identity remapping, allocation, binding and transactional output.

source_context.schema: DXF group 5 is each object record's own identity. MotionPath group-340 camera/target/view references and CurvePath group-340 entity reference are distinct graph edges.
source_context.implementation_gap: dxfRW::writeMotionPath and dxfRW::writeCurvePath mapped their typed group-340 references but emitted each object's source handle unchanged and did not bind that identity to the emitted record.

implementation.behavior: A supplied object identity is remapped, checked against invalid and fixed output handles, reserved, emitted as group 5, and bound to the emitted source-object identity after serialization. A zero/no-source identity is allocated. RecordStateScope and DxfWriterRecordScope preserve transactional state and bytes.
implementation.reference_policy: Typed references retain resolver-first behavior and remain independent from the object's own identity remap.
implementation.failure_behavior: The generated matrix rejects unresolved typed references before publication and verifies corrected fresh-writer retry. No native or external failure behavior is inferred.

validation.input: Generated in-memory records only; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
controls: MOTIONPATH group-5 identity remaps independently of its three group-340 references
ACDBCURVEPATH group-5 identity remaps independently of its group-340 entity reference
resolver and source-remap paths both preserve typed scene-object reference output
unresolved references preserve the destination and corrected fresh-writer retry passes

qualification_limits: Generated controls do not establish complete physical MotionPath or CurvePath producer coverage or source graph closure.
No independent native consumer, camera-path behavior, or scene evaluation was validated.
This transport fix does not promote scene-path support claims.
